title: Night-time Lights and Development in Ghana
publisher: Ghana Statistical Service - Data Science Unit

nightlight_sources.se_: VIIRS VNL annual (EOG v2.1/v2.2), district zonal stats by exact-extract (R); lit threshold 1.0 nW
nightlight_sources.so_: VIIRS VNL annual, socio-economic team's extraction (03a_socioeconomic/nightlight_panel_enriched.csv)
nightlight_sources.gdp: VIIRS DNB monthly composites (VCMSLCFG), aggregated to quarters, national

caveats: The two district nightlight panels (se_ and so_) come from different extractions and disagree; both are kept in district_panel.csv with distinct prefixes. Do not mix them in one chart without saying so.
Offinso North has no Gi* value: the 03c queen-contiguity graph found no neighbour for it (a boundary topology gap), so its 'Not significant' hotspot class is a default, not a test result.
Expected gaps in districts.csv: 7 newly-lit districts have no CAGR/decomposition (zero lit area in 2012); 4 districts dark in 2012 have no convergence growth.
AfDB-DI4A workshop code may be reused for the front end only, with attribution ('Source: AfDB-DI4A', changes stated).
